description: The three airline-agent decisions a2, a6 and a7 side by side, with no edges: the one relationship the policy states between them (the delayed-flight certificate is offered only after the reservation has actually been changed or cancelled) is a relationship between a completed action and a decision, and this format's edge can only feed one decision's outcome id into another's inputs, so it is recorded verbatim in RESIDUE.md instead of being declared here.

change-flights.description: May the flights in this reservation be changed? Decides permissibility only; the policy relates it to the compensation decision through the change having been carried out, which no edge of this format can carry (RESIDUE.md item 1).

cancel-flight.description: May this reservation be cancelled? Decides permissibility only; the policy relates it to the compensation decision through the cancellation having been carried out, which no edge of this format can carry (RESIDUE.md item 1).

refund-compensation.description: Is the user owed a refund or compensation, and what kind? Named as the result because it is the decision the policy makes conditional on the other two, but its /reservation/changeOrCancelCompleted gate is fed by the caller, not by an edge (RESIDUE.md item 1).
